## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
#install.packages(c("crosstalk", "plotly", "DT", "bslib"))
#install.packages('sf')
#install.packages('bsicons')
#install.packages('shiny')
library(tidyverse)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(readxl)
library(gt)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
library(crosstalk)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(bslib)
library(htmltools)
library(bsicons)
library(shiny)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
# --- MA'LUMOTLARNI TAYYORLASH (FAQAT BIR MARTA ISHLAYDI) ---

# Ma'lumotlarni oldindan saqlangan fayldan o'qish
kobo_data <- readRDS("kobo_data.rds")
child_table_name <- "hh_member"

# Jadvallarni ajratish
household_raw <- kobo_data
household_raw[[child_table_name]] <- NULL 
temp_for_unnest <- kobo_data[c("_uuid", child_table_name)]
hh_members_raw <- temp_for_unnest %>% unnest(all_of(child_table_name), names_sep = "/")

# Nomlarni o'zgartirish
dict_household <- read_excel("nomlar_lugati_household.xlsx") %>% filter(!is.na(yangi_nom))
rename_vec_hh <- setNames(dict_household$eski_nom, dict_household$yangi_nom)
household_clean <- household_raw %>% rename(any_of(rename_vec_hh))

# ... hh_members uchun ham nomlarni o'zgartirish kerak bo'lsa, shu yerga qo'shing ...

# Yangi ustunlarni yaratish (recode)
household_clean <- household_clean %>%
  mutate(
    туман = case_when(
      district == 1  ~ "Конимех тумани", district == 2  ~ "Қизилтепа тумани",
      district == 3  ~ "Навбаҳор тумани", district == 4  ~ "Кармана тумани",
      district == 5  ~ "Нурота тумани", district == 6  ~ "Томди тумани",
      district == 7  ~ "Учқудуқ тумани", district == 8  ~ "Хатирчи тумани",
      district == 9  ~ "Навоий шаҳри", district == 10  ~ "Зарафшон шаҳри",
      district == 11  ~ "Ғозғон шаҳри", .default = "Номаълум"
    )
  )

# Vaqtni hisoblash va yakuniy jadvalni yaratish
household_final <- household_clean %>%
  mutate(
    sana = as.Date(`_submission_time`),
    start_time = ymd_hms(start),
    end_time = ymd_hms(end),
    duration_minutes = as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "mins"))
  ) %>%
  filter(duration_minutes >= 1 & duration_minutes <= 180, !is.na(sana))


# --- INTERAKTIV MANTIQ (SERVER QISMI) ---

# 1. Reaktiv filtr yaratish
filtered_data <- reactive({
  # Foydalanuvchi tanlagan tuman va sanani olamiz
  tanlangan_tuman <- input$tuman_filter
  boshlanish_sana <- input$sana_filter[1]
  tugash_sana <- input$sana_filter[2]

  # Asosiy ma'lumotlarni filtrlaymiz
  data_to_filter <- household_final %>%
    filter(sana >= boshlanish_sana & sana <= tugash_sana)
  
  # Agar "Barcha tumanlar" tanlanmagan bo'lsa, tuman bo'yicha ham filtrlaymiz
  if (tanlangan_tuman != "Barcha tumanlar") {
    data_to_filter <- data_to_filter %>% filter(туман == tanlangan_tuman)
  }
  
  data_to_filter
})

# 2. Qiymat kartalari (value box) uchun renderlar
renderValueBox({
  value_box(
    title = "Tanlangan so'rovnomalar soni",
    value = nrow(filtered_data()),
    showcase = bs_icon("bar-chart-line-fill"), theme = "primary"
  )
})

renderValueBox({
  avg_dur <- filtered_data() %>%
    summarise(avg = mean(duration_minutes, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(avg)
  
  value_box(
    title = "O'rtacha davomiylik",
    value = paste(round(avg, 1), "daqiqa"),
    showcase = bs_icon("clock-history"), theme = "secondary"
  )
})

# 3. Interaktiv jadval uchun render
renderDT({
  datatable(
    filtered_data(),
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(pageLength = 5, dom = 'Bfrtip', buttons = 'excel'),
    colnames = c('ID' = 'id', 'Tuman' = 'district', 'Intervyuer', 'Vaqt' = 'sana')
  )
})

# 4. Kunlik dinamika grafigi uchun render
renderPlot({
  daily_summary <- filtered_data() %>% count(sana, name = "soni")

  ggplot(daily_summary, aes(x = sana, y = soni)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#28B463") +
    geom_text(aes(label = soni), vjust = -0.5) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %d") +
    labs(title = "Kunlik so'rovnomalar soni", x = "Sana", y = "Soni") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
})


tumanlar_listi <- c("Barcha tumanlar", unique(household_final$district))

# Tuman tanlash uchun ochiladigan menyu
selectInput(
  "tuman_filter", 
  label = "Tumanni tanlang:",
  choices = tumanlar_listi,
  selected = "Barcha tumanlar"
)

# Sana oralig'ini tanlash uchun kalendar
dateRangeInput(
  "sana_filter",
  label = "Sana oralig'ini tanlang:",
  start = min(household_final$sana),
  end = max(household_final$sana),
  language = "uz"
)
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
